reason: Reviewed Evotec SE's 2023 Annual Report (20-F equivalent) in its entirety. The document contains extensive discussion of business model, strategy, partnerships, R&D platforms, and financial performance. However, no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figure or market size estimate is disclosed by the company itself. The report focuses on operational metrics (5,061 employees, 93 nationalities, 838 alliances, 298 customers, etc.) and financial results but does not quantify the addressable market opportunity for drug discovery and development services or biologics manufacturing. References to 'market' are qualitative (e.g., 'paradigm shift in biopharma,' 'sharing economy in R&D') without numerical market sizing.
